name: Tomoki Nakamoto
source:
Likes: Sports, working, massages, travel
Dislikes: Expensive stuff, doing nothing

(Kickstarter)
An average guy who is a workaholic and very cynical about life. After usually being dumped with work he has developed a sarcastic persona. He is trusted by others for his work ethic but recently he's been burnt out.

(Facebook)
A workaholic that doesn't have many friends. He looks like any other regular people that you can find anywhere, but he has his own charm that make people comfortable to talk or to spend with.

He is a Full-timer employee at Schwarz Bank.  At his office, he spends his time mostly with his mate, Hisami and his boss, Rald Schwarz.
